problem: drone routing with swarm synchronization
finding: MILP and ALNS solve drone routing with dynamic swarms, yielding insights on detours, swarm use and multi-trip benefits.

problem: two-echelon VRP with pickups, deliveries and deadlines
finding: ALNS reduces operating cost by up to 17.54% vs current practice; tighter hub deadlines (same-day) raise cost by 8.27%.

problem: e-cargo bike multi-trip heterogeneous VRP with rider fatigue
finding: Chance-constrained model cuts total energy use by 27.2% vs deterministic models while riders retain 62.8% more available time.

problem: VRP with simultaneous pickup and delivery and time windows (e-commerce returns)
finding: SA and SA-TS solve the VRPSPDTW effectively, improving first/last-mile coordination and efficiency in e-commerce logistics.

problem: bus-drone collaborative rural delivery scheduling and routing
finding: Bus-heterogeneous drone system achieves notable cost reduction and better delivery performance, robust to drone and bus-stop parameters.

problem: fleet size and mix electric VRP with time windows
method: fleet size and mix VRPTW model with energy consumption
finding: A fleet mixing vehicle technologies (incl. electric) can reduce last-mile costs.

problem: review
method: literature review of two-echelon truck-UAV routing formulations
finding: Classifies GV-UAV two-echelon routing by connection mechanisms and calls for new formulations for mobile satellite synchronization and coupling.

problem: review
method: literature review of electric VRP, arc routing, team orienteering
finding: Reviews electric vehicle routing/arc routing/team orienteering work and shows numerically the gains of optimization methods.

problem: parallel drone scheduling VRP
finding: No abstract; title indicates a min-cost truck-drone parallel scheduling routing problem.

problem: parcel locker location
finding: Covering 90% of estimated demand requires 10-11 automated parcel lockers on average.

problem: VRP for last-mile company
finding: ML-retrieved initial solutions reduce branch-and-bound computation time for new routing problems.

problem: VRP with heterogeneous locker boxes
finding: Metaheuristic handles routing with multi-size locker packing and shows how locker station configurations perform under demand scenarios.

problem: grocery locker location-routing (2-echelon)
method: 2-echelon LRP and VRP optimization model; decision support system
finding: 2-echelon LRP/VRP DSS determines refrigerated grocery locker locations and cargo-bike routes minimizing total cost.

problem: parallel drone scheduling VRP with collective drones
finding: CP models achieve state-of-the-art results for the single-truck case and give insights into the multi-truck variant.

problem: locker-drone delivery network design
method: stochastic optimisation; sample average approximation with genetic algorithm
finding: Multi-capacity drone systems need fewer lockers and drones, and locker-drone systems are more cost-efficient than conventional drone delivery.

problem: load-dependent electric VRP with time windows
finding: No abstract; title indicates a LNS matheuristic for load-dependent EVRPTW.

problem: flying sidekick TSP (truck-drone)
finding: Compact ILP solves FS-TSP* to optimality for up to 20 customers and quantifies completion-time gains of allowing truck waiting.

problem: truck-drone routing and drone configuration
finding: Inverting the truck-drone problem identifies best drone range and speed for given delivery density; metaheuristics beat best-in-class algorithms.

problem: heterogeneous fleet VRP (large-scale)
method: matheuristic: ML decomposition and set covering
finding: Decomposition-set covering framework yields high-quality HVRP solutions and several new best-known benchmark solutions.

problem: capacitated VRP for perishable goods distribution
finding: ACO cut travel distance by 41.93% and 30.96% and costs by 15.6% and 2.03% for two vehicles.

problem: TSP with drone
finding: Hybrid metaheuristic finds optimal routes for benchmark TSP-D instances and improves some best-known solutions.

problem: electric two-echelon VRP
finding: No abstract; title indicates an electric two-echelon VRP study.

problem: VRP with lunch breaks, time windows and heterogeneous fleet (furniture delivery)
method: MILP; multi-start randomized local search heuristic
finding: Ignoring driver pauses during optimization leads to infeasibilities; the heuristic efficiently solves large industrial instances.

problem: VRP with crowdshipping
finding: No abstract; title indicates a service-centric VRP with crowdshipping.

problem: multivisit drone routing with edge launches
method: covering salesman lower bound; iterative method with MISOCP
finding: Iterative method is effective and launching drones along edges is shown to be valuable.

problem: 2-echelon VRP with capacitated satellites and reverse flows
finding: No abstract; title indicates a matheuristic for a 2E-VRP with capacitated satellites and reverse flows.

problem: multi-depot VRP with time windows (motorcycle delivery)
finding: ACO-3-opt outperforms standard ACO, reducing mileage and operational costs for motorcycle last-mile delivery.

problem: truck-drone routing with flight-level selection and time windows
finding: The TDRP-FT model and hybrid algorithm determine how drone flight levels should be selected across instance sizes.

problem: review
method: survey of VRP formulations and computational intelligence methods
finding: Emerging VRP variants (last-mile, same-day, crowdshipping, UAV delivery) are increasingly solved with CI and hybrid methods.

problem: drone routing with battery wear and fleet sharing
finding: Branch-and-price solves the multi-objective drone routing problem, showing the effectiveness of blockchain-enabled fleet sharing.

problem: flexible park-and-loop routing
method: MILP; hybrid LNS with set partitioning
finding: HLNS is effective, and parking and customer time/space flexibility reduce operational costs.

problem: UAV routing with multiple time windows
finding: Hybrid ALNS outperforms baselines in solution quality and runtime (best solutions in ~39 s per instance).

problem: urban logistics centre location and vehicle routing
finding: Candidate urban logistics centre sites were evaluated; electric N2 vehicle range is at the limit of required route lengths.

problem: multi-trip time-dependent VRP with time windows
finding: No abstract; title indicates an accelerated Benders algorithm for the multi-trip time-dependent VRPTW.

problem: electric VRP with time windows, partial recharges and parcel-locker covering locations
method: MIP; variable neighborhood search; set partitioning
finding: VNS finds new best-known EVRPTW-PR solutions and shows effects of self-pickup options and compensation on last-mile network design.

problem: VRP route usability / hidden constraints
finding: ML models can learn hidden constraints (time windows, capacity, precedence) and classify routes by practical usability.

problem: dynamic VRP with time window assignment
finding: Wider time windows generally raise service level, though not for all instances.

problem: VRP with simultaneous pickup and delivery in rural areas under uncertain demand
finding: No abstract; title indicates a rural pickup-delivery VRP with uncertain demand and government subsidy.

problem: two-echelon urban logistics coordination (parcel-to-satellite assignment)
method: bilevel leader-follower game; cutting-plane algorithm; constraint learning heuristic
finding: Game-theoretic coordination can reduce emissions while respecting stakeholder preferences such as on-time delivery.

problem: balanced p-median districting for last-mile delivery
method: bi-objective MILP; Lagrangian relaxation with VNS
finding: Algorithm handles large last-mile districting instances, revealing trade-off between assignment cost and allocation inequity.

problem: rich VRP decision support
finding: LLM-optimization hybrid improves adaptability of decision support on rich last-mile VRPs.

problem: joint order packing and multi-temperature delivery routing (cold chain e-fulfilment)
finding: Joint model improves average total cost by 3.26% and satisfaction by 47.88% vs traditional strategy.

problem: truck multi-drone pollution routing with pickup and delivery and variable speeds
method: MIP; ALNS with speed-optimizing local search
finding: Drone deployment cuts total cost ~40% and speed optimisation adds 7-11% savings on average.
